questions.question_english: A school Principal is managing the Imprest account. At the end of the month, the Imprest Register shows an expenditure of ₹2,500 out of an advance of ₹5,000, supported by valid vouchers. What action should the Principal take?
options_english: Submit a contingent bill for ₹2,500 to PAO with vouchers to restore imprest
Retain the remaining cash balance of ₹2,500 and request the government for a fresh ₹5,000 advance
Surrender the entire initial imprest advance of ₹5,000 and close the imprest account permanently

questions.explanation_english: Submit a contingent bill for ₹2,500 to PAO with vouchers to restore imprest. questions.question_english: Review the following items of expenditure: I. Telephone and internet charges. II. Purchase of a new school minibus. III. Routine maintenance of office equipment. IV. questions.question_english: Consider the two statements below: Assertion (A) and Reason (R): Assertion (A): While preparing Budget Estimates, historical data of the previous three years’ expenditure is usually analyzed. questions.question_english: Review the following statements regarding Utilization Certificates (UC): I. UCs must be submitted strictly within 12 months of the closure of the financial year in which the grant was released. II. Non-submission of UCs can lead to the withholding of future grants. III. questions.explanation_english: I and II only. questions.question_english: Due to prolonged medical leave, a Principal wishes to delegate their DDO powers to the Vice Principal. How is this legally executed in government schools?
options_english: Obtain formal HoD orders declaring the VP as DDO and attest signatures in PAO
Hand over the office physical keys, cash box, and chequebook to the Vice Principal informally
Issue an internal school office order signed exclusively by the outgoing Principal

questions.explanation_english: Obtain formal HoD orders declaring the VP as DDO and attest signatures in PAO. Delegating Drawing and Disbursing Officer powers during extended leave requires formal administrative authorization. The Principal must obtain official orders from the competent Head of Department declaring the Vice Principal as DDO, followed by attesting the VP’s specimen signatures with the Pay and Accounts Office. Informal handovers or internal office orders carry no legal validity

questions.question_english: A Principal decides to implement Zero-Based Budgeting (ZBB) principles for the school’s annual science exhibition. What will be the most likely approach taken under this method?

questions.question_english: Select the correctly matched pair regarding the type of budget and its core characteristic:

Performance Budget – Groups expenditures strictly by specific functional categories or physical objects like stationery and salaries
Line-Item Budget – Emphasizes strict control over inputs and category spending limits
Zero-Based Budget – Assumes the previous year’s finalized budget as the mandatory baseline for calculating the next year’s allocation
questions.explanation_english: Line-Item Budget – Emphasizes strict control over inputs and category spending limits. Line-Item budgeting inherently focuses on controlling input costs by strictly enforcing ceiling limits on specific categories of spending, such as personnel costs or material supplies.
